title: Dead --approve remnants stand in runners.cloud.toml and runners.local.toml
body:
The common file's implement cell is q6z's named target, but the same dead pairing survives in the two routing files a worker's boundary does not let a tick write: .tick/runners.cloud.toml's [roles.implement] still carries args = ["--approve"], and it flows into any named config's resolution whose own cell declares no args; .tick/runners.local.toml's [roles.implement.tiers.frontier] carries args = [], a clearing of the line the common file is to drop. The cloud file's [configs.claude.roles.implement] also keeps an args = [] whose comment explains clearing the --approve. All inert, all misleading the same way; fold them into the same operator edit as q6z's paste.
evidence: .tick/runners.cloud.toml:24 and :155-162; .tick/runners.local.toml:16
